payload.reason: The evidence provides specific correlations between different variants of ROUGE scores and their effectiveness in evaluating scientific summarization, indicating that different variants yield different correlation values with human judgments.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in different correlation values with human judgments, with ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 showing better correlations for scientific summarization.
ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L have weak correlations with human pyramid scores, while ROUGE-3 has the highest correlation among the variants.
The effectiveness of ROUGE as an evaluation metric for scientific summarization is challenged by weak correlations with manual evaluations, indicating variability among ROUGE variants.
